canta: Documented rootless Android pre-installed/user-app removal through Shizuku fits that Android task (C2/C3).
Community recommendations are documented on the homepage, not independently validated safety evidence.
Critical-app removal can bootloop and require factory reset (C4); some oplus removals are restricted (S2).
breathingRoom: The reused capability register supports Mac storage exploration and grouped process views, not an Android replacement.
Breathing Room, which we build, is a macOS 13+ preview (identified version 0.1.0-preview.1), with Python 3.10+ prerequisite and no Developer ID signing/notarization established in the register.
Free local core; advertised optional AI Care $5 USD/month or $50 USD/year, renewal/tax conditions apply. Hosted AI needs authentication/internet and sends relevant context; not all-offline AI (BR1).
Source implementation and illustrative previews are not release/runtime tests or measured savings. Recheck applicable material claims before any future draft.
